description: Checks whether a product holds a Matter certificate on the CSA (Connectivity Standards Alliance) Distributed Compliance Ledger, using MatterCatalog's published read of the ledger (the same index as its "Is it Matter certified?" lookup page). Takes a product name, brand, model, part number or CSA certificate ID. Returns the matching ledger models with certificate IDs, certification dates, software and Matter versions, CSA device type and network (Thread, Wi-Fi or Ethernet), the date of the ledger read, and the MatterCatalog product page with that page's own certification answer and store names where one exists; also MatterCatalog pages for matching products that are not on the ledger (bridged or claim-only). No prices.

limit.description: How many ledger models to show (1-10).

query.description: Product name, brand + model, part number or CSA certificate ID, e.g. 'Aqara U200', 'Eve Energy', 'Tapo P125M', 'CSA22084MAT40084-24'.

name: check_matter_certification
title: Is it Matter certified?
